title: 🔢 Count rows
description: Total row count of the selected table

dialects.default:
SELECT 
  column_name,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM {table}
GROUP BY column_name
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: 💾 Tables by disk size
description: Rank database tables by total disk space

dialects.mysql:
-- MySQL: Tables ranked by disk size
SELECT 
  table_name AS `Table`,
  ROUND(((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024), 2) AS `Size (MB)`,
  table_rows AS `Est. Rows`
FROM information_schema.TABLES 
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY (data_length + index_length) DESC 
LIMIT 15;
dialects.postgresql:
-- PostgreSQL: Tables ranked by disk size
SELECT 
  schemaname || '.' || relname AS "Table",
  pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS "Total Size",
  pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS "Data Size",
  pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid) - pg_relation_size(relid)) AS "Index Size",
  n_live_tup AS "Est. Rows"
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables
JOIN pg_stat_user_tables USING (relid)
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC
LIMIT 15;

dialects.mysql:
-- MySQL: Index details
SHOW INDEX FROM {table};
dialects.postgresql:
-- PostgreSQL: Indexes and usage scans for table
SELECT 
  indexrelname AS "Index Name",
  pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(indexrelid)) AS "Index Size",
  idx_scan AS "Index Scans",
  idx_tup_read AS "Tuples Read"
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE relname = '{rawTableName}'
ORDER BY idx_scan DESC;

title: ⚡ Active running queries
description: Inspect active threads, sessions and slow queries

dialects.mysql:
-- MySQL: Active running queries
SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST;
dialects.postgresql:
-- PostgreSQL: Active queries & running sessions
SELECT 
  pid,
  usename AS "User",
  client_addr AS "Client IP",
  state,
  age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS "Duration",
  query AS "Query"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state != 'idle' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
ORDER BY query_start ASC;

title: ⚙️ DB Version & Environment
description: View database version, current user and active database/schema

dialects.mysql:
-- MySQL: Version, user and active database
SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_version, CURRENT_USER() AS user, DATABASE() AS current_db;
dialects.postgresql:
-- PostgreSQL: Version, user and active schema
SELECT version() AS pg_version, current_user, current_database(), current_schema();
